question: What was the year-over-year percentage growth in total crimes?
agent_sql_query:
WITH yearly_counts AS (
    SELECT "YEAR" AS yr, COUNT(*) AS total_crimes
    FROM crime_incidents
    GROUP BY "YEAR"
), growth AS (
    SELECT
        yr,
        total_crimes,
        LAG(total_crimes) OVER (ORDER BY yr) AS prev_total,
        ROUND(
            100.0 * (total_crimes - LAG(total_crimes) OVER (ORDER BY yr))
            / NULLIF(LAG(total_crimes) OVER (ORDER BY yr), 0),

    FROM yearly_counts
)
SELECT

    total_crimes AS "TOTAL_CRIMES",

FROM growth
ORDER BY yr;

question: What are the top 5 districts (by name) with the largest increase in arrest rate from 2020 to 2024?
ground_truth_sql:
SELECT dn.district_name,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ci."YEAR" = 2024 AND ci."ARREST" = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ci."YEAR" = 2024 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)
       - ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ci."YEAR" = 2020 AND ci."ARREST" = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ci."YEAR" = 2020 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS arrest_rate_change
FROM crime_incidents ci JOIN district_names dn ON ci."DISTRICT" = dn.district_id
WHERE ci."YEAR" IN (2020, 2024)
GROUP BY dn.district_name
ORDER BY arrest_rate_change DESC LIMIT 5;
agent_sql_query:
WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT
        ci."DISTRICT" AS district_id,
        ci."YEAR" AS yr,
        COUNT(*) AS total_incidents,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ci."ARREST" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS arrests
    FROM crime_incidents ci
    WHERE ci."YEAR" IN (2020, 2024)
    GROUP BY ci."DISTRICT", ci."YEAR"
),
pivot AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(y2020.district_id, y2024.district_id) AS district_id,
        y2020.total_incidents AS total_2020,
        y2020.arrests AS arrests_2020,
        y2024.total_incidents AS total_2024,
        y2024.arrests AS arrests_2024
    FROM (SELECT * FROM yearly WHERE yr = 2020) y2020
    FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM yearly WHERE yr = 2024) y2024
        ON y2020.district_id = y2024.district_id
)
SELECT
    dn.district_name,
    ROUND(
        100.0 *
        ( (arrests_2024::numeric / NULLIF(total_2024, 0)) -
          (arrests_2020::numeric / NULLIF(total_2020, 0)) ),
        2
    ) AS arrest_rate_increase_pct
FROM pivot p
JOIN district_names dn ON dn.district_id = p.district_id
ORDER BY arrest_rate_increase_pct DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;

question: Which ward (by name) had the single highest number of weapon crimes in any one year?
